name: San Lorenzo Scenic Viewpoint
description: San Lorenzo Lookout stands out as one of the must-visit spots in Manta. With its breathtaking panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean, it’s an ideal destination for sightseeing, snapping photos, and soaking in the beauty of nature. Guests can unwind while taking in the gorgeous coastal landscape.

name: Museo Centro Cultural Manta
description: The Manta Cultural Center Museum is an amazing spot to dive into the history and culture of Manabí. Here, visitors can wander through fascinating ancient artifacts, captivating art exhibits, and discover the vibrant heritage of Ecuador.

name: Santa Marianita
description: Santa Marianita Beach is truly one of the gems close to Manta. With its powerful winds and breathtaking ocean vistas, it’s a favorite spot for kitesurfing, unwinding, and soaking in those incredible sunsets.

name: Mega Parque Agustin Intriago Manta
description: Megapark Agustín Intriago is a vibrant, modern park located in Manta, featuring lush green spaces, fun playgrounds, and stunning views of the city. It's the perfect spot for families to enjoy some quality time together and engage in various outdoor activities.

name: Playita Mia
description: Playita Mía is a traditional coastal area in Manta where visitors can experience the city's fishing culture. It is known for its seafood market, local fishermen, and beautiful ocean views, making it a unique place to explore local life and traditions.

name: La Quadra
description: La Quadra is a popular place in Manta where visitors can enjoy shopping, restaurants, and entertainment. It offers a modern and relaxing atmosphere for families and tourists.
